entries.message: Improve cross-platform sync and onboarding while making Up Next reliably include watched shows and select the first released unwatched episode.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Add reviewable one-time Tautulli history imports with safe merges and preserved watch dates.
Tweak: Improve cross-platform sync and onboarding while making Up Next reliably include watched shows and select the first released unwatched episode.
Tweak: Keep Up Next aligned with media-page watch state, episode release dates, and TV-show actions.
Tweak: Standardize settings sections, help guides, backup controls, and onboarding access.
Tweak: Surface sync outcomes, retries, and unresolved media matches in the Sync Activity hub.
Tweak: Improve provider-aware watch-state synchronization and recovery safeguards.
Tweak: Up Next now checks every previously watched show, so new episodes are no longer missed because of a recency cap.
Tweak: Keep the Up Next rail on the first released unwatched episode instead of jumping to a later season.

entries.message: Fix - Keep Up Next stable while watch state syncs
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Fix: Keep Up Next stable while watch state syncs
Fix: Keep stale watched or unwatched cards out of Up Next until an authoritative refresh confirms their removal.
Fix: Animate matching Up Next cards as Saving while watch and unwatch actions sync.
Fix: Match pending actions by show identity and episode coordinates so rematches do not affect the wrong title.

entries.message: Discover recommendations are now more personal and controllable.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Personalize recommendations from recent watch history.
Feature: Let users choose Don't recommend to remove unwanted movies and shows from the personalized rail.
Fix: Restore Jellyfin watched, resume, and rating imports against current API field rules.

Fix: Hide Clear progress unless a resume item has a positive playback position.
Tweak: Keep recommendation exclusions saved across refreshes and browsers.
Tweak: Hide watched titles and improve poster recovery across Discover.
Tweak: Improve card metadata hierarchy, summary readability, and release-date presentation across personal lists.
